command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_probe true; sleep 10; echo '=== focus ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys window | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -n 8 || true; echo '=== probe logs ==='; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -Ei 'AiCallBridge|ShizukuUserServiceProbe|ShizukuCallMediaUserService|offcall_parity_ok|prepared_|active_|heartbeat_|service_uid|service_pid|EX_SECURITY|invalid attr|Cannot create AudioRecord|ShizukuServiceStarter' | tail -n 320 || true); printf '%s
' "$OUT"; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'service_uid=2000'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'prepared_after_prepare=true'; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'offcall_parity_ok=true'; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'invalid attr'; then echo unexpected_invalid_attr=true; exit 31; fi; echo phase2c_attributed_rx_offcall_ok=true
